# Client Picker, Media Sidebar & Fixes (beta 3)

Third test build of v1.3.0. Fixes from beta 2 testing: volume control, Home Assistant's own Emby connections hidden from the client list, a leftover media player on the server device removed, and the client list sorted. Full notes below.

The biggest release of Emby (Modern) so far. It brings in the v1.2.7 beta work, fixes several features that weren't working, and gives you control over which Emby clients appear in Home Assistant.

Please read **Breaking changes** before updating.

### New
- **Choose your Emby clients.** Pick which apps and devices become Home Assistant devices, during setup or later under the **settings cog**. Selected clients are permanent and show as **Off** when idle, instead of appearing and disappearing.
- **New client notices.** When an unselected client connects, a **Repairs** notice offers to add it. Choose Ignore to stop seeing it. Tools that can't be controlled, such as other Home Assistant integrations, Music Assistant and Infuse, are skipped.
- **Media sidebar.** Browse and play your Emby libraries in Home Assistant's **Media** panel. Emby transcodes the stream so any browser can play it.
- **Server updates.** The update entity now shows the latest Emby Server release and its release notes. Install is offered only on servers that can update themselves; Linux service, Docker and LXC installs can't.
- **Re-authentication.** If Emby stops accepting the API key, Home Assistant asks for a new one instead of failing.
- **Diagnostics.** Download a debug file from the integration page, with API keys and addresses removed.

### Fixed
- **Media browser** in media players works again, including sending media to a client.
- **Seek** now works, and media players show playback position and duration.
- **Stop playback** from the media player's power button. The Home Assistant media card doesn't show a separate Stop button for players that can pause.
- **Volume** changes show straight away instead of waiting for the client to report back.
- **Shutdown Courtesy Mode** now sends its warning to viewers, and remembers its setting after a restart.
- **Server Status** now shows Restarting and Shutting down.
- **Duplicate entities.** Remote and Stop Session were created again on every reconnect. There is now one of each per device, and the old duplicates are removed.
- **Library counts** use the right item type per library. TV libraries count series, with episodes as an attribute. Photos and audiobooks are now counted; before, they always showed 0.
- A library that fails to load keeps its last count instead of dropping to 0.
- Live session updates no longer delay server info and library refreshes.
- Device icons for Android TV and NVIDIA Shield.
- Volume control on stricter clients such as Android TV and NVIDIA Shield.

### Changed
- **Entity names and IDs include the device name**, for example `button.sams_server_restart` and `media_player.lounge_tv`.
- **Disabled by default on new installs:** Remote, Stop Session, Shutdown, and sensors for empty libraries. Enable them on the device page if you use them. Existing entities keep their current setting.
- **Library counts** refresh when Emby reports a library change, plus an hourly check, instead of every 10 seconds. This greatly reduces load on the server.
- **Episode titles** are shown as `S01:E05 - Title`.
- `send_message` can target one server with the new optional **Emby server** field.
- Emby branding ships with the integration.

### Breaking changes
- **Entity IDs.** Automatic IDs from earlier versions, such as `button.restart` or `media_player.emby_modern_…`, are renamed once to the new style. IDs you set yourself are left alone. Update any automations, scripts or dashboards that use the old IDs.
- **Remote and Stop Session** entities are replaced with new per-device ones, which have new entity IDs.
- **Server Status values** are now `running`, `restarting`, `shutting_down` and `unreachable`. Update automations that compare against `Running`.
- **Music library sensors** now count albums, with tracks as an attribute.

### Upgrade notes
- Your existing client devices are kept and selected automatically. Review them under the settings cog and untick any you don't want.
- **Check your entity IDs after updating.** Only IDs that match the old automatic pattern are renamed. If any still look old-style, open the entity's settings and change its Entity ID, then update automations and dashboards that use it. The Repairs page can help find dashboards that reference missing entities.
- Requires Home Assistant 2025.2 or later. Tested on 2026.2.
- Update from **Settings → Updates**, then restart Home Assistant.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sambarlick/emby/compare/v1.2.8...v1.3.0-beta-3
